Jim has the strong support of both North Carolina Senators, Ted Budd and Thom Tillis. Jim has served as the District Attorney of Forsyth County since 2009, and has been a prosecutor in that office since 1997. He has a deep track record of being tough on crime, and preserving Law and Order. Jim is a graduate of Duke University (where he played varsity lacrosse), and New York Law School.
